recipe.laptop-generate.py:
import json
from dojo.simlab import paths
from dojo.simlab.gen_layouts import generate
for task in ('store_laptop_and_headphones', 'store_laptop_and_headphones_random'):
    root = paths.LAYOUTS / task
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for i in range(100030,100045):
        p = root / f'{i}.json'
        if p.exists():
            raise RuntimeError(f'refuse overwrite {p}')
        p.write_text(json.dumps(generate(task,i,variant=11,seed_salt='laptop-2026-11-07-88c48b74'),indent=1))
        print(task,i,flush=True)
recipe.laptop-job.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
name="$1"; shift
export RD_HOME="$HOME/dojo-robodojo" DOJO_DATA="$HOME/dojo-data/laptop"
export DOJO_CATALOG="$HOME/dojo-data/skills4/catalog:$HOME/dojo-data/skills3/catalog:$HOME/dojo-perception-data/catalog"
export SIMLAB_GPU=0 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
cd "$HOME/controlr-laptop"
exec 9>>"$HOME/dojo-gpu-light7.lock"
flock -w 120 9
source scripts/dojo/disk_guard.sh
disk_guard laptop
who > "$DOJO_DATA/logs/$name.admission"
nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,process_name,used_memory --format=csv >> "$DOJO_DATA/logs/$name.admission"
used=$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits)
printf 'time=%s used_MiB=%s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$used" >> "$DOJO_DATA/logs/$name.admission"
[[ "$used" -le 24576 ]] || exit 75
printf 'pid=%s stream=LAPTOP start=%s\n' "$$" "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" > "$HOME/dojo-gpu-light7.lock"
exec timeout -k 60 1800 systemd-run --user --scope -q -p MemoryMax=8G -p CPUQuota=600% scripts/simlab/rdpy.sh -u "$@"
recipe.laptop-panel.py:
import json, hashlib, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.home()/'dojo-data/laptop'
tasks=['store_laptop_and_headphones','store_laptop_and_headphones_random']
manifest={}
for task in tasks:
    d=root/'simlab/layouts'/task
    idx=json.loads((d/'settled_index.json').read_text())
    ids=[i for i in range(100032,100045) if idx.get(str(i),{}).get('status')=='ok'][:10]
    assert len(ids)==10,(task,ids)
    manifest[task]=[{'id':i,'sha256':hashlib.sha256((d/f'{i}.settled.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for i in ids]
(root/'panel-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2))
for task in tasks:
    ids=[r['id'] for r in manifest[task]]
    for group,arm in [(0,'off'),(1,'on'),(0,'on'),(1,'off')]:
        selected=ids[group::2]
        name=f'{task}-{arm}-{group}'
        cmd=['bash',str(root/'job.sh'),name,'-m','dojo.skills.g3','run','--task',task,'--seeds',','.join(map(str,selected)),
             '--skill-attr','hang_cradle=straddle','--skill-attr',f'headset_seat={arm}','--trace','--out',str(root/name)]
        with (root/'logs'/f'{name}.log').open('w') as log:
            result=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        with (root/'panel-progress.jsonl').open('a') as f:
            f.write(json.dumps({'name':name,'rc':result.returncode})+'\n')
        if result.returncode:
            raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
(root/'panel-done').write_text('complete\n')
